notes: Read whole from MaxPreps' tournament pages on 2026-11-16 by lib/sources/maxpreps-tournament.ts, one division page at a time (/tournament/<tournament>/<bracket>/….htm; the site answered 403 to faster reads). The pages were found from last season's team schedules: each bracket game's tournamentCanonicalUrl under the prior sportSeasonId. Each bracket's `url` is the page MaxPreps names canonical.

CCS: the CIF Central Coast Section 2026 Girls' Soccer Championships (tournament ba4fb1a4-13d8-4669-9d3e-dfe36c6c2341), Divisions I-V; the tournament's list page names no other division (no Open Division).
CIF State: the 2026 CIF State Girls Soccer Championships (tournament c84f3b42-1d74-4412-bd27-3d0a3fe51738), the three divisions a team of ours played in: I, II and IV.
A level game MaxPreps marks a winner of was decided on penalty kicks; the page gives the level score and the winner, not the tally.
